Tier 28 is the group of armor sets associated with the patch 9.2.0 and the Sepulcher of the First Ones. This tier marks the return of true tier sets, with set bonuses and a unique appearance for each class. It was accompanied by the introduction of the Catalyst as a deterministic method of obtaining tier pieces. Completing one of these sets will grant the First Wonders achievement.
